config.heading: Premier Coaching for Competitive & Entrance Exams

courses.title: WBP (West Bengal Police Exam)
courses.desc: Targeted preparation for Constable and SI posts, focusing on prelims and mains syllabus, exam-oriented practice sets, and physical efficiency guidance.

courses.title: SSC GD (General Duty)
courses.desc: Comprehensive coaching for CAPF constable recruitment covering Elementary Mathematics, General Intelligence, Reasoning, and Hindi/English language skills.

courses.title: WBPSC Miscellaneous
courses.desc: Deep-dive coverage of General Studies, Arithmetic, and descriptive English/Bengali papers aligned with the official WBPSC three-stage selection pattern.

courses.title: GNM Nursing Entrance (ANM/GNM)
courses.desc: Focused preparation for state nursing entrance tests, emphasizing Class 10/12 Life Science, Physical Science, basic arithmetic, and grammar essentials.

courses.title: B.Sc. Nursing (JENPAS UG)
courses.desc: Advanced foundation coaching covering 10+2 Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Basic English, and Logical Reasoning specifically mapped to nursing degree entrance exams.

courses.title: Current Affairs for Various Exams
courses.desc: Daily and monthly national, international, and state-level event breakdowns with high-yield MCQs, static GK integration, and revision notes.

courses.title: Math for Various Competitive Exams
courses.desc: Concept-building and shortcut-driven problem-solving covering Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, and Mensuration tailored for speed and accuracy.

courses.title: General Science for Various Exams
courses.desc: NCERT-based core coverage of Physics, Chemistry, and Biology fundamentals, emphasizing frequently asked conceptual questions across state and central exams.
